column4: 快走吧，不然你要迟到了。
column5: Hurry up, otherwise you will be late.
column6: 不然 starts a new clause and means "if not". The longer form 要不然 is also common in speech.

column3: to go on foot; to walk
column4: 从这儿到学校，步行只要十分钟。
column5: From here to the school it takes only ten minutes to walk.
column6: 步行 is walking as a way of getting somewhere. For a walk for pleasure or exercise, say 散步.

column4: 这个星期我睡眠不足，很累。
column5: My sleep has been insufficient this week, and I am very tired.
column6: 不足 is also a noun, "a shortcoming" (他的不足). Before a number it means "less than" (不足一百人).

column4: 他长大以后想当足球裁判。
column5: When he grows up, he wants to be a football referee.
column6: 裁判 is also a verb, "to judge" a game.

column4: 记者正在采访那位老人。
column5: The reporter is interviewing that old man.
column6: 采访 is what a reporter does to collect news. A job interview is 面试.

column3: to adopt; to take (action or measures)
column4: 我们必须采取行动，不能再等了。
column5: We must take action; we cannot wait any longer.
column6: 采取 goes with abstract things: 采取行动, 采取办法.

column4: 这张照片是彩色的。
column5: This photo is in colour.
column6: 彩色 means "in colour". Its opposite is 黑白 (black and white).

column3: to adopt; to use (a method, plan or material)
column4: 公司采用了他的新办法。
column5: The company adopted his new method.
column6: 采用 means to pick something and use it. 采取 is used for taking action or measures.

column3: to consult; to refer to; reference
column4: 写作文的时候，可以参考这本书。
column5: When you write an essay, you can refer to this book.
column6: 参考 is also a noun, "reference": 参考书 is a reference book.

column4: 他在一家餐饮公司工作。
column5: He works at a catering company.
column6: 餐饮 is a business word for the restaurant trade. In daily talk people say 吃饭.

column3: to take part in; to be involved in
column4: 学生们都参与了这个活动。
column5: All the students took part in this activity.
column6: 参与 is a little more formal than 参加. It often means to be involved in something (参与讨论).

column4: 孩子把糖藏在床下面了。
column5: The child hid the sweets under the bed.
column6: 藏 is read cáng when it means "to hide". It is read zàng in 西藏 (Tibet).

column3: to operate; to handle (a machine); operation
column4: 这台机器很容易操作。
column5: This machine is very easy to operate.
column6: 操作 is also a noun, "an operation" (操作简单 = simple to operate).

column4: 这套书一共有三册。
column5: This set of books has three volumes altogether.
column6: 册 counts bound volumes. It is also part of words like 手册 (handbook).

column4: 医生给我测了体温。
column5: The doctor measured my body temperature.
column6: 测 means to measure with an instrument: 测体温, 测血压.

column4: 老师今天要测试我们的听力。
column5: The teacher is going to test our listening today.
column6: 测试 is also a noun, "a test".

column4: 他曾在国外住过三年。
column5: He once lived abroad for three years.
column6: 曾 is the written form of 曾经. It comes before a verb and often goes with 过. 曾 is also a surname, read Zēng.

column3: once; at some time in the past
column4: 我曾经去过那个地方。
column5: I once went to that place.
column6: 曾经 says something happened in the past and is over. It often goes with 过 after the verb.

column3: to insert; to plug in; to stick into
column4: 请把花插在水里。
column5: Please stick the flowers in water.
column6: 插 is to push something into something else: 插花 (to arrange flowers), 插电 (to plug in).

column4: 这两个词的意思有一点儿差别。
column5: There is a small difference in meaning between these two words.
column6: 差别 is a difference that can be big or small (差别很大). Here 差 is read chā, not chà.

column4: 他和别人的差距越来越小。
column5: The gap between him and the others is getting smaller.
column6: 差距 is a gap in level, distance or amount (差距很大 = a big gap).

column4: 吃面条的时候，我喜欢用叉子。
column5: When I eat noodles, I like to use a fork.
column6: 叉子 is a fork. Chopsticks are 筷子.

column3: to take apart; to pull down; to unwrap
column4: 他把旧桌子拆开了。
column5: He took the old table apart.
column6: 拆 means to take something apart or open it up: 拆开, 拆房子, 拆礼物 (to unwrap a gift).

column4: 这个地方产茶，很有名。
column5: This place produces tea and is very famous.
column6: 产 is mostly used inside words (产品, 产量, 出产). On its own it needs an object: 产茶, 产米.

column4: 今年的产量比去年高。
column5: This year's output is higher than last year's.
column6: 产量 is how much is produced, in a factory or on a farm.

column4: 这家公司的产品卖得很好。
column5: The products of this company sell very well.
column6: 产品 is something a company makes and sells. 东西 is any "thing".

column4: 旅游是这个城市最大的产业。
column5: Tourism is the biggest industry in this city.
column6: 产业 is a whole line of business, such as the travel industry. 工业 is factory industry.

column4: 每个人都有自己的长处。
column5: Everyone has strengths of their own.
column6: 长处 is a good quality or skill. Its opposite is 短处 (weak point). 长 is read cháng here.

column4: 这条路的长度是五公里。
column5: The length of this road is five kilometres.
column6: 长度 is the measurement of how long something is. 长 is read cháng.

column4: 这不是一个长久的办法。
column5: This is not a lasting solution.
column6: 长久 describes something that lasts a long time, for example 长久的关系 (a lasting relationship) or 长久之计 (a long-term plan).

column4: 他长期住在国外。
column5: He has lived abroad for a long time.
column6: 长期 is a long stretch of time. Its opposite is 短期. Before a noun it means "long-term": 长期计划.

column4: 这是生活常识，大家都应该知道。
column5: This is common knowledge about daily life; everyone should know it.
column6: 常识 is knowledge that every normal person is expected to have.

column4: 我想尝试一种新的学习方法。
column5: I want to try a new way of studying.
column6: 尝试 is to try something new. It can also be a noun, "an attempt". The everyday word for "try" is 试.

column4: 他坐长途汽车回家。
column5: He goes home by long-distance bus.
column6: 长途 comes before a noun: 长途汽车, 长途电话, 长途旅行.

column4: 我们要想得长远一点儿。
column5: We should think a little more long-term.
column6: 长远 looks far into the future: 长远的计划. 长期 is a long period; 长远 is about looking ahead.

column4: 公共场所不能抽烟。
column5: You cannot smoke in public places.
column6: 场所 is a place where people do some activity, such as 公共场所 (public place).

column4: 这辆车超了前面的那辆车。
column5: This car overtook the car in front.
column6: 超 means to go beyond or pass. It is also a prefix, as in 超市 (supermarket).

column4: 这次旅行用的钱超出了我们的计划。
column5: The money spent on this trip went beyond our plan.
column6: 超出 is followed by a range or limit: 超出计划, 超出范围.

column4: 他是一个超级足球迷。
column5: He is a super football fan.
column6: 超级 comes before a noun (超级市场). In speech it is also used before adjectives: 超级好吃 = super tasty.

column3: to speed; to go over the speed limit
column4: 开车超速很危险。
column5: Speeding when you drive is very dangerous.
column6: 超速 is a verb plus object, so it splits: 超了速.

column4: 我家的窗户朝南。
column5: The windows of my home face south.
column6: 朝 is also a preposition: 朝前走 (walk straight ahead). A 朝 is also a dynasty.

column4: 外面太吵了，我睡不着。
column5: It is too noisy outside; I cannot sleep.
column6: 吵 is also a verb, "to quarrel" (吵架), and "to disturb with noise" (别吵我).

column4: 妈妈在厨房里炒菜。
column5: Mum is stir-frying dishes in the kitchen.
column6: 炒 is cooking in a hot wok with a little oil: 炒饭, 炒面, 炒菜.

column4: 路上发生了车祸，路被堵住了。
column5: A car accident happened on the road, and the road is blocked.
column6: 车祸 is a traffic accident. You say 发生车祸 (a car accident happens).

column4: 他的车停在车库里。
column5: His car is parked in the garage.
column6: 车库 is the place to park a car, in a house or building.

column4: 这条路上的车辆很多。
column5: There are many vehicles on this road.
column6: 车辆 is a general word for cars, buses and trucks together. For one car say 一辆车.

column4: 他的座位在第五节车厢。
column5: His seat is in the fifth carriage.
column6: 车厢 is a train carriage. Its measure word is 节.

column4: 车主把车停在了路边。
column5: The owner of the car parked it by the road.
column6: 车主 is the person who owns a car.

column4: 我们要彻底解决这个问题。
column5: We must solve this problem thoroughly.
column6: 彻底 means all the way, with nothing left. It usually comes before a verb: 彻底改变.

column4: 这个箱子太沉了，我拿不动。
column5: This box is too heavy; I cannot carry it.
column6: 沉 means "heavy" for things (很沉) and "to sink" in water (沉下去).

column4: 他沉默了一会儿，没有回答。
column5: He was silent for a moment and gave no answer.
column6: 沉默 is to stay silent when you could speak. It is also an adjective: 他很沉默.

column4: 请你帮我称一下这个箱子。
column5: Please weigh this box for me.
column6: 称 is read chēng when it means "to weigh" or "to call". It is read chèn in words like 对称 and 称心.

column3: to call; to be known as
column4: 人们把狗称为人类的朋友。
column5: People call dogs the friend of humans.
column6: 把 A 称为 B means "to call A B". 被称为 B means "to be known as B".

column4: 老师常常称赞他学得很认真。
column5: The teacher often praises him for studying so seriously.
column6: 称赞 is to say good things about someone or their work. You can also use it as a noun: 得到称赞.

column4: 这个产品的成本很低。
column5: The cost of this product is very low.
column6: 成本 is what it costs a business to make something. 价格 is the price a buyer pays.

column4: 他愿意承担这次的责任。
column5: He is willing to take responsibility for this.
column6: 承担 goes with 责任, 费用 and 工作: 承担责任 is to take on responsibility.

column4: 这件事很复杂，我只了解到一定的程度。
column5: This matter is complicated; I only understand it to a certain degree.
column6: 程度 is how far something goes. 一定的程度 means "a certain degree"; 到了……的程度 means "to the point that...".

column4: 请看一下这种饮料的成分。
column5: Please take a look at the ingredients of this drink.
column6: 成分 is what something is made of, like the ingredients on a label.

column4: 这是我们一年努力的成果。
column5: This is the result of a year of our hard work.
column6: 成果 is a good result won by long work. 结果 is any kind of result.

column4: 他在工作上取得了很大的成就。
column5: He has made great achievements in his work.
column6: 成就 is also a verb, "to accomplish". 取得成就 means to make achievements.

column3: to found; to set up; to hold true
column4: 这家公司是二十年前成立的。
column5: This company was set up twenty years ago.
column6: 成立 also means "to hold true": 这个说法不成立 = that claim does not hold.

column4: 他今年十八岁，已经成年了。
column5: He is eighteen this year and has already reached adulthood.
column6: 成年 is to grow up to be an adult. 成年人 means an adult.

column4: 这个城区有很多公园和商店。
column5: This part of the city has many parks and shops.
column6: 城区 is the built-up part of a city. 城市 is the whole city.

column4: 成人票比儿童票贵。
column5: An adult ticket costs more than a child's ticket.
column6: 成人 is an adult. 成人票 is an adult ticket. As a verb it means "to grow up" (长大成人).

column4: 他承认自己做错了。
column5: He admitted that he had done wrong.
column6: 承认 is to say that something is true, such as a mistake or a fact.

column4: 他一个人承受着很大的压力。
column5: He is bearing a lot of pressure alone.
column6: 承受 means to take a heavy weight or a hard thing without breaking. It can be physical or about feelings.

column4: 这些苹果已经成熟了。
column5: These apples have already ripened.
column6: 成熟 is "ripe" for fruit and "mature" for people (他很成熟). 熟 alone is read shú or shóu, and in 成熟 it is shú.

column4: 飞机上的乘务员很热情。
column5: The attendants on the plane are very friendly.
column6: 乘务员 works on a train or a plane and looks after the passengers.

column4: 他在公司写电脑程序。
column5: He writes computer programs at a company.
column6: 程序 is also a procedure, the steps of doing a thing in order (工作程序).

column3: member (of a group, team or family)
column4: 他是我们学习小组的成员。
column5: He is a member of our study group.
column6: 成员 is a person who belongs to a group, such as a family, team or company.

column4: 孩子们在快乐的环境中成长。
column5: Children grow up in a happy environment.
column6: 成长 is growing up in body and mind, or developing. It is also used for companies and ideas.

column4: 这个橙子又大又甜。
column5: This orange is big and sweet.
column6: 橙子 is the fruit. 橙色 is the colour orange.

column4: 池里有很多红色的小鱼。
column5: There are many small red fish in the pond.
column6: 池 is mostly used inside words: 水池, 游泳池, 电池 (battery). On its own it sounds a little written.

column4: 大雨持续了三天。
column5: The heavy rain lasted for three days.
column6: 持续 means going on without a break for a time. 继续 is to go on doing something after a pause.

column4: 请借我一把尺子。
column5: Please lend me a ruler.
column6: 尺子 is the everyday word for a ruler. Its measure word is 把.

column4: 小鸟的翅膀受伤了。
column5: The little bird's wing is hurt.
column6: 翅膀 is the wing of a bird or an insect.
